report.clinical_summary: Patient with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia reports severe fatigue, infections, fog, and headaches since starting medication. The illness has significantly impacted work, parenting, and daily functioning, with life feeling 'put on hold.' Patient experiences constant worry, anger, frustration, despair, and exhaustion. Medication is seen as essential to prevent progression, but severe headaches and side effects have raised concerns. Patient engages in small self-care activities (short walks, routines) and is open to professional support.
